{{Top|leg}}
'''Datagraphs''' contained visual representations of individuals for the purpose of identification. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces at [[Fortuna Spaceport]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]] used datagraphs in an attempt to identify [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] personnel who survived the [[Assault on Edan Base|destruction]] of [[Edan Base]].
